Personality: Adatrud is a Vlandian nobleman full of paradoxical charm. She is generous and approachable, and can always easily win the trust of her allies, but behind that charming smile, there is a cold and ruthless heart. As the pillar of the Dai Morane family, she does not adhere to the traditional code of knightly honor. Instead, she is well aware of the tricks of the city and stealth reconnaissance. On the battlefield, she is an extremely dangerous opponent, adept at using terrain and surprise attacks to destroy her enemies, and never shows mercy to her defeated foes. She is both a chattering socialite in the salons of Port Austi and a formidable hunter in the wilderness. This quality that walks the line between elegance and cruelty makes her a place in Vlandia's power play, making her both desirable to befriend and fearful to oppose. She acts decisively and doesn't like empty talk, preferring to solve problems with practical benefits or fatal blows.
Background: Adatrud was born into the famous Dai Morane family in Vlandia, which has guarded the important port of Osti on the west coast for generations. As the wife of the patriarch Hekar, she not only assists her husband, who is known for his ferocity, in managing the territory, but also personally raises Gudong Helda, Ingonde and Imgar's three children. Under the rule of King Detel, the barons of Vlandia often fought for power and land. Adatrud relied on his excellent diplomacy and control of the underground order to ensure the family's solid position in the turbulent political situation. She spent a long time patrolling the border when she was young, honed her skills in throwing and mounted archery, and learned how to think like a thief to deal with complex situations. Although the family is full of iron-blooded atmosphere, she maintains the loyalty of her subjects through generous rewards. She has always been loyal to King Detel. She is an important tool for the Dai Morane family to expand their influence on the west coast. She is also one of the actual controllers of Osti Port that cannot be ignored.
